old: Artificial intelligence has overtaken geopolitical tensions and interest rates as the top near-term worry for the U.S. financial system in the Federal Reserve Board's semiannual Financial Stability Report, published on November 13, 2026.[^1][^2][^3]
new: Artificial intelligence has overtaken geopolitical risks and an oil shock as the most cited near-term risk among market contacts surveyed for the Federal Reserve Board's semiannual Financial Stability Report, published on November 13, 2026.[^1][^2][^3][^6]
why: In the spring 2026 survey geopolitical risks and an oil shock led, not interest rates (which ranked low and rose this fall); the 87% ranking reflects surveyed market contacts, not the Board's own view.
